hero.title: Who We Are
body: DSR Design and Engineering Solutions is a multidisciplinary engineering firm dedicated to delivering innovative, efficient, and reliable design solutions for a rapidly evolving industrial world. Established in 2016, DSR was founded with a single mission to be the best CAD Services provider globally in multiple industries and value add to the End User.

What began as a small design office with a handful of engineers has evolved into a trusted technology and engineering partner serving clients across automotive, aerospace, heavy machinery, manufacturing, and industrial automation sectors.
At DSR, we believe that great engineering is more than technical accuracy - it's about creating solutions that inspire progress, sustainability, and performance.

details.title: A detailed design engineering partner for industrial growth.
paragraphs: DSR Design Solutions is a detailed design engineering company supporting oil and gas, petrochemical, industrial, infrastructure, and manufacturing projects. We help clients with engineering documentation, CAD, BIM, project support, manpower services, and technical training that are practical, compliant, sustainable, and future-ready.

Our approach combines technical depth, project execution capability, and industry knowledge. From early design coordination to construction-ready deliverables, we focus on clear communication, reliable documentation, and disciplined quality review at every stage.

card.title: Quality, EHS, and information discipline guide our work.

journey.title: Our Journey
journey.body: From our humble beginnings to industry leadership, explore the key milestones that have shaped our company.

items.title: The Beginning
items.body: DSR was founded to deliver world-class mechanical design services, beginning with CAD design and drafting built on accuracy and timely delivery.

items.title: First Major Breakthrough
items.body: Secured our first international oil and gas project from Azerbaijan, delivering 3D modeling and API-standard design calculation support.

items.title: Expanding Horizons
items.body: Expanded into product design, FEA, reverse engineering, and prototype development, while winning a detailed engineering contract from BHEL.

items.title: Adapting to Global Change
items.body: Adopted digital collaboration and cloud-based design systems to deliver remote engineering support and complete projects on schedule.

items.title: Infrastructure and Innovation
items.body: Inaugurated a modern design and development center with CAD, CAM, CAE, prototyping, and simulation capabilities.

items.title: Engineering for the Future
items.body: Advanced sustainable design, automation, and smart manufacturing solutions while expanding across the U.S., Europe, Middle East, and Southeast Asia.

leadership.body: DSR's leadership blends global education, technical expertise, and hands-on industry experience. Their collective vision drives the company to deliver world-class engineering services trusted by enterprises globally.
